system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Lava Release due to their close affinity to both Fire and Earth Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Lava Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or Fire respectively.

Also, when encountering a seal or barrier, formed of a jutsu or effect meant to impede someone from progressing forward or through it, you can spend 10 minutes pouring your Magma release chakra into it, causing it to crack, and splinter until you destroy it at the end of the duration. You can only destroy seals or barriers in this way or a Rank equal to the highest rank jutsu your class allows for your level. For barriers and seals of a higher rank, you can make an ability check using your highest jutsu modifier, vs the Standard Jutsu DC of the target barrier or seal.
